title: How to Start Catfish Farming in Nigeria
author: WittyFare Editorial Team
description: A practical guide to starting a catfish farm in Nigeria.
content:
Introduction

Catfish farming can be a rewarding business when properly planned. Start by identifying your market, choosing a suitable pond system and preparing your water supply.

Preparing your farm

Choose a location with reliable water, good drainage and access to your market. Select a pond system that matches your budget and management capacity.

Choosing fingerlings

Buy healthy fingerlings from a reputable hatchery. Check their size and condition before stocking.

Feeding and management

Use appropriate feed sizes, monitor water quality and keep records of feed consumption and fish growth.

Conclusion

Start with a manageable stocking level and plan your market before investing.

title: Why Broiler Chickens Grow Slowly
author: WittyFare Editorial Team
description: Understand the factors that affect broiler growth.
content:
Introduction

Slow growth in broilers can result from several management problems.

Feed quality

Provide appropriate feed for the age and production stage of your birds.

Water supply

Ensure clean drinking water is always available.

Temperature and ventilation

Maintain suitable brooding temperatures and good ventilation.

Health management

Watch for unusual signs and seek veterinary advice when necessary.

title: What to Check Before Buying a Power Station
author: WittyFare Editorial Team
description: Understand power capacity, output and battery specifications.
content:
Introduction

Choosing a portable power station requires understanding your electricity needs.

Battery capacity

Check the watt-hour rating and estimate how long your appliances will run.

Output power

Make sure the continuous output can support your appliances, including their starting requirements.

Warranty

Check warranty conditions, local support and availability of replacement parts.

title: Five Records Every Small Farm Should Keep
author: WittyFare Editorial Team
description: Simple records that help farmers manage costs and income.
content:
Introduction

Good record keeping helps you understand the performance of your farm.

Purchases

Record feed, equipment, livestock and other purchases.

Production

Record stocking numbers, production output and feed consumption.

Sales

Record customers, sales, payments and expenses.

Conclusion

Review your records regularly to identify opportunities to improve profitability.

title: How to Prevent Coccidiosis in Broiler Chickens
description: Learn practical ways to prevent coccidiosis in broiler chickens, maintain good poultry hygiene and reduce farm losses.
author: WittyFare Editorial Team
content:
Understanding Coccidiosis

Coccidiosis is an important poultry health challenge caused by protozoan parasites. It can affect the growth and performance of broiler chickens.

Prevention measures

Maintain dry litter, provide clean drinking water, avoid overcrowding and follow good biosecurity practices. Consult a qualified veterinarian when birds show signs of illness.

Conclusion

Good management, early observation and appropriate veterinary guidance can help reduce the impact of coccidiosis on your farm.
